ENTER_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.title: Enter Bizarre Fragment
ENTER_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.INITIAL.des: You notice a rift in the corner of Kazdale — an immature idea gave birth to it, yet failed to make it whole. Looking at the scene unfolding within the rift, you decide...
ENTER_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.INITIAL.opt: Consume [red]2[/red] Plans and enter the Bizarre Fragment
A branch that can bear no fruit can only become nourishment for other stories (gain [blue]1[/blue] Plan)
ENTER_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.EXIT.descri: The rift disappears, leaving some piecemeal cognition in your mind.
EXIT_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.title: Exit Bizarre Fragment
EXIT_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.INITIAL.desc: You go to the end of the rift, but you still don't see the end of the story, you just have to move on.
EXIT_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Leave the Bizarre Fragment and continue your adventure
EXIT_BIZARRE_FRAGMENT.pages.EXIT.descrip: The rift disappears, leaving some piecemeal cognition in your mind.
FATED_ENCOUNTER.title: Fated Encounter
FATED_ENCOUNTER.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: A black beast clamps its jaws around its prey's throat until the prey stops struggling and goes limp in its mouth. Suddenly, a flash of golden light cuts across the wilderness — a creature never seen before. Its mane glistens in the sunlight, and its sharp teeth and claws betray its might. What is that? The black beast sets down its prey, locks eyes with the newcomer, and then...
FATED_ENCOUNTER.pages.INITIAL.options.GA: Shares its prey with the creature
FATED_ENCOUNTER.pages.GAIN_DOODLE_OF_HOP: After countless years, people of different races have long since become indistinguishable from one another. Cooperation brings mutual benefit — that is the consensus of all.
FATED_ENCOUNTER.pages.GAIN_TALONS_OF_HAT: The Sarkaz kill their prey, and the prey's descendants will kill the Sarkaz in turn. It is kill or be killed — Terra offers no second path.
FATED_ENCOUNTER.pages.GAIN_LAMP_OF_WISHE: It was at that moment that Tikaz heard an earnest wish — the creature before it wished to never be hungry again. So Tikaz gave up its prey, watching as it died of gluttony and became its own fine meal. Alas, from then on people only remembered that Tikaz could grant wishes. They kept wishing, and wishing, until at last they brought ruin upon both Tikaz and themselves.
SARKAZ_COMMON_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.option: Nymph's imagination is right before your eyes.
